title: Example plug-in
description: Lumiverb's example of a plug-in: it adds a few facts to each photo and video (a caption you choose, when it was taken, its shape), finds a few famous places when you set a location, and shows how a plug-in runs, says what it reads, and how its settings look and are checked.
author: Lumiverb

settings.label: Caption
settings.help: The caption it gives each clip. Anything but "nothing": the plug-in checks that itself. Changing it asks what becomes of the captions already made.

settings.label: Tag
settings.help: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, or nothing. Lumiverb checks the form before saving.

settings.label: Service key
settings.help: The server's, not an account's: only the server admin sees and sets it, and it's never shown again.
